g.text: US-06: Signal Correlation - Proximity candidate triggers composite if signal loss found; one composite per episode
Runs on Kafka consume from proximity.candidates.
SIGNAL_LOSS was already emitted when entity went dark.
If proximity arrives within the correlation window,
the SIGNAL_LOSS is superseded — not suppressed.
Each signal-loss episode can produce at most one COMPOSITE.
Check each entity for an active or recent signal loss.
Entity is currently dark and no composite issued yet.
targeted lookup for proximity episode context
[no active signal loss — check recent-loss window]
Entity resumed broadcasting but was dark recently.
Position Consumer wrote recent-loss before deleting alert-state.
Its presence means the correlation opportunity is still open.
[recent-loss found AND episode_start_ms within window of resumed_at_ms]
targeted lookup for proximity episode context
Subsequent proximity events for this entity
find no recent-loss and produce UNSCHEDULED_PROXIMITY
as independent incidents — not further composites.
[no qualifying signal loss for either entity]
